name: CPU Solid Voxelization
definition: A CPU-based algorithm that fills voxels inside a mesh by projecting triangles onto the YZ plane, sorting vertices, and scanning lines across the projected bounding box to determine interior voxels.
summary: CPU Solid Voxelization deterministically converts triangle meshes into solid voxel grids via Y-Z plane projection and X-axis sweeping, using exact geometric rasterization rather than probabilistic ray sampling.
